bio.title: My Story
paragraphs: I'm a passionate Game Audio Designer currently studying at Howest University of Applied Sciences in Belgium, pursuing a degree in Digital Arts & Entertainment with a specialization in Game Audio.

My journey into audio began with a deep love for music and a curiosity about how sound shapes our emotional experiences in games. This passion led me to explore the technical side of audio implementation, from middleware systems like Wwise and FMOD to custom audio programming in Unreal Engine and Unity.
I believe that great game audio is invisible when it's working—it should seamlessly blend into the experience, enhancing every moment without drawing attention to itself.
